subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Buying a new car can __cost an arm and a leg__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Be expensive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"cost an arm and a leg"** means to be very expensive. (बहुत महंगा होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Buying a house in the city centre can **cost an arm and a leg**.
 
 
 
• **"Expensive"** refers to something that costs a lot of money or is high-priced. (महंगा)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Be free** (मुफ्त होना): To not cost any money.

 
 
• **Example:** The public library membership is **free**.
 
 
 
• **Be affordable** (सस्ती होना): To be reasonably priced.
 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone model is quite **affordable**.
 
 
 
• **Be reasonable** (वाजिब होना): To be fair or moderate in price.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel offered **reasonable **rates for its rooms.
